title: Typical Wookiee Family
description: "TYPICAL WOOKIE FAMILY" is the way artist Joe Johnston described this drawing (front) based on a skit for the 1978 STAR WARS Holiday Special on CBS-TV. The main characters are Chewbacca's father Itchy, Chewbacca, his wife Malla, and his mischievous son Lumpy. Wookiees live on the planet Kashyyyk, where the jungle is so dense, they can walk on the treetops. Their houses, circular wooden structures (back), are built on the treetops as shown in a painting by Ralph McQuarrie.
